[DEPRECATED] Diff two analysis runs by vuln_id set.

Use ``POST /api/v1/compare`` (ADR-0008) for new integrations — it produces

This endpoint is preserved for back-compat and will be removed once

Replaces the legacy bucket-and-weight scorer. See
``app/services/risk_score.py`` for the full formula and rationale.

Response shape (additive — old keys preserved for client compat):
    sbom_id            int
    run_id             int                (NEW)
    total_risk_score   float
    risk_band          "CRITICAL"|...
    components         list[dict]
    worst_finding      dict|None          (NEW) the highest-scoring CVE
    kev_count          int                (NEW) findings on CISA KEV
    epss_avg           float              (NEW) mean EPSS across findings
    methodology        dict               (NEW) formula + sources

Return the persisted 8-stage validation report for an SBOM.

Always returns a row for any ``SBOMSource`` that exists, even rows
that predate migration 012 (those report ``status='validated'`` with
empty entries). The frontend's detail-page report section is the
primary consumer; the JSON download affordance also calls this
endpoint and serialises the response verbatim.
Return parsed metadata about the stored SBOM without running analysis.

**Manager path (``granularity`` set):** period-bucketed
(day/week/month/year) distinct-active snapshots from ``findings.trend``,
optionally filtered to ``application_ids``, with ``fix_available`` and
``resolved`` overlays on each point. Annotations are omitted for periods >
a day (they're day-scoped event markers).

AgeBuckets.title: AgeBuckets
AgeBuckets.description:
CVE-age bucket counts for the "Vulnerability by Age" pie.

Age = ``now - published_on``. ``unknown`` holds findings with no usable
published date. Sums to the in-scope total.

AiFixBundle.title: AiFixBundle
AiFixBundle.description:
The atomic unit of AI fix output.

Cached as a single row in :class:`~app.models.AiFixCache` keyed on
``(vuln_id, component_name, component_version, prompt_version)``.

``overall_confidence`` is the model's self-assessed confidence in the
*entire* response (distinct from the per-section ``confidence`` fields on
:class:`RemediationProse` and :class:`DecisionRecommendation`, which scope
only their own recommendation). It is surfaced prominently at the top of
the AI-fix UI so a reader can calibrate trust before reading the detail.
Model self-reported, not server-clamped — defaults to ``"medium"`` when
omitted, matching the neutral default used by the per-section fields.

AiFixError.title: AiFixError
AiFixError.description:
Structured error surface for the orchestrator.

Failed generations are reported, not raised. The batch worker continues
past per-finding errors so a single bad provider response can't take
down a 1,000-finding scan.

The Phase 5 upstream-failure fields (``upstream_status_code``,
``upstream_message``, ``retry_after_seconds``, ``retry_after_human``,
``provider_name``, ``model_name``) are populated whenever a concrete
provider attached an :class:`~app.ai.providers.base.UpstreamFailure`
to the raised :class:`~app.ai.providers.base.AiProviderError`. Older
code paths leave them ``None``.

severities.title: Severities
severities.description: Restrict to findings with one of these severities.

kev_only.title: Kev Only
kev_only.description: Restrict to findings whose CVE is on the CISA KEV list.

fix_available_only.title: Fix Available Only
fix_available_only.description: Restrict to findings whose ``fixed_versions`` is a non-empty array.

search_query.title: Search Query
search_query.description: Substring match against vuln_id, component_name, title.

finding_ids.title: Finding Ids
finding_ids.description: Explicit finding IDs (overrides filter predicates when non-empty). Always intersected with the run's findings at the SQL layer for security.

label.title: Label
label.description: Human-readable scope label for the progress banner (e.g. 'Critical findings', 'Selected (12)'). The frontend supplies this; the backend stores it verbatim.

AiFixGenerationScope.title: AiFixGenerationScope
AiFixGenerationScope.description:
User-supplied scope spec for a batch generation request.

All fields optional. Empty scope (or ``None``) means "all findings
in the run."

Filter precedence:
  * If ``finding_ids`` is non-empty, it wins (explicit selection).
  * Otherwise, filter predicates apply conjunctively.

AiFixMetadata.title: AiFixMetadata
AiFixMetadata.description: Per-bundle provenance — what produced it, when, and at what cost.

AiFixResult.title: AiFixResult
AiFixResult.description:
Generator output — bundle + metadata.

Returned to the API surface; the orchestrator's batch helper aggregates
a list of these.

AiUsageBucket.title: AiUsageBucket
AiUsageBucket.description: One row of a per-purpose / per-provider breakdown.

AiUsageSummary.title: AiUsageSummary
AiUsageSummary.description: Top-level payload for the cost dashboard.

window_days.title: Window Days
window_days.description: Window size used for the aggregation.

AiUsageTotals.title: AiUsageTotals
AiUsageTotals.description: Aggregate cost / call counts for a window.

BatchProgress.title: BatchProgress
BatchProgress.description: Snapshot of a batch run's state. Frontend reads this verbatim.

parent_sbom_id.title: Parent Sbom Id
parent_sbom_id.description: Existing SBOM this upload is a new version of. Sets the parent/child link that Version History, compare-versions and restore read. Omit for a standalone SBOM.

set_as_current.title: Set As Current
set_as_current.description: Set this upload as the Product's current SBOM.

ComponentChangeKind.title: ComponentChangeKind
ComponentChangeKind.description:
Per-component diff event class.

Identity for the diff is ``(name_lower, ecosystem)`` where ecosystem is
derived from the PURL via ``app.services.cve_service._purl_ecosystem``.
Falls back to ``(name_lower, "unknown")`` when PURL is missing — see
ADR-0008 §7.1 for the documented limitation.

``LICENSE_CHANGED`` and ``HASH_CHANGED`` are stubs. They never fire today
because the underlying columns aren't stored. They're additionally hard-
guarded behind ``Settings.compare_license_hash_enabled`` so that if
someone adds the columns without finishing the wiring, the change_kinds
still won't quietly activate. See ADR-0008 §10 OOS and Phase 3 user
clarification §4.

ComponentDiffRow.title: ComponentDiffRow
ComponentDiffRow.description: One row in the Components tab of the Compare view.

ConnectionTestResult.title: ConnectionTestResult
ConnectionTestResult.description:
Outcome of a credential's "Test connection" probe.

Designed for the Settings UI: one structured result that the
frontend translates into a typed banner (green check / amber
warning / red error). The ``error_kind`` enum is the discriminator
— never parse ``error_message`` to decide UX.

CredentialUpdateRequest.title: CredentialUpdateRequest
CredentialUpdateRequest.description:
Body for ``PUT /credentials/{id}``.

All fields optional — present fields update, omitted fields preserve.
Critically, ``api_key`` omitted means "keep the existing key".

CveBatchResponse.title: CveBatchResponse
CveBatchResponse.description: Response for ``POST /api/v1/cves/batch`` — keyed by canonical CVE ID.

CveDetail.title: CveDetail
CveDetail.description:
The normalised CVE detail payload the modal consumes.

Always returns a value — the service degrades gracefully when upstream
sources fail (``is_partial=True``, ``sources_used`` records the survivors).

CveDetailWithContext.title: CveDetailWithContext
CveDetailWithContext.description: Scan-aware variant — adds component context + upgrade recommendation.

CveExploitation.title: CveExploitation
CveExploitation.description: Exploitation-likelihood signals for the 'How is it exploited?' section.

package.title: Package
package.description: Affected package name within the ecosystem

fixed_in.title: Fixed In
fixed_in.description: First version that fixes this CVE

CveFixVersion.title: CveFixVersion
CveFixVersion.description: One fix-version row, scoped to a (ecosystem, package) pair.

CveReference.title: CveReference
CveReference.description: External reference link surfaced in the modal footer / fix sections.

CveResultStatus.title: CveResultStatus
CveResultStatus.description:
Outcome discriminator the frontend reads to pick the correct banner.

  OK          — at least one source returned data; the payload is fully usable.
  PARTIAL     — at least one source contributed; at least one other failed.
  NOT_FOUND   — every queried source returned NOT_FOUND. ID is well-formed,
                no upstream record exists yet (newly-published advisories,
                pre-CVE-assignment GHSA, etc).
  UNREACHABLE — every queried source errored / timed out. The payload is
                a degraded shell (modal still renders the row data the
                client already had); user should retry.

CveScanContext.title: CveScanContext
CveScanContext.description: Component context appended by the scan-aware endpoint variant.

CveSeverity.title: CveSeverity
CveSeverity.description:
Severity bucket. Lowercase to match the JSON wire format the modal
consumes; the existing ``AnalysisFinding.severity`` column carries the
uppercase form, so the service layer normalises on the way in.

DashboardPostureResponse.title: DashboardPostureResponse
DashboardPostureResponse.description:
v2 posture envelope.

Adds the fields the v2 hero needs to render without a second round-trip:
``total_findings``, ``distinct_vulnerabilities`` (previously on
``/dashboard/stats``), ``net_7day`` envelope (with ``is_first_period``),
and the server-computed ``headline_state`` + ``primary_action`` rules.
The flat ``net_7day_added`` / ``net_7day_resolved`` fields are preserved
for one release while the FE migrates to the envelope.

unknown_count.title: Unknown Count
unknown_count.description: Deprecated. There is no UNKNOWN effective status (VEX-STAT-001); source-level unknown folds into under_investigation_count per spec section 8. Retained for backward compatibility only.

DashboardVexResponse.title: DashboardVexResponse
DashboardVexResponse.description:
``GET /dashboard/vex`` (VEX-API-001).

Two totals coexist deliberately (VEX-DASH-001). The analyser finding total
lives on the posture response; ``total_contexts`` here is the reconciled
union of analyser findings and mapped VEX assertions after deduplication.
They are not forced equal, because legitimate VEX-only vulnerabilities
exist.

Invariant (VEX-DASH-002): ``total_contexts == affected_count +
not_affected_count + fixed_count + under_investigation_count`` for mapped
contexts. ``unresolved_mapping_count`` is reported separately and excluded
from the total, so an unresolved mapping can never make risk look smaller.

DecisionRecommendation.title: DecisionRecommendation
DecisionRecommendation.description:
Structured 'should you act on this now' advice.

``citations`` enumerates the data sources the model used. We don't
require these to map 1:1 with the grounding context's ``sources_used``
list, but a model that cites ``kev`` when KEV data wasn't provided is
flagged as a low-confidence hallucination during post-validation.

candidate_id.title: Candidate Id
candidate_id.description: Required for RECOMMEND; optional check for ACCEPT

EstimateResponse.title: EstimateResponse
EstimateResponse.description:
Pre-flight estimate used by the CTA card.

Always reflects the *current* scope: filters / selection drive the
finding set, the cache count is computed in a single SQL join, and
the per-call latency / cost projections come from the same
estimator the legacy GET endpoint uses.

FindingChangeKind.title: FindingChangeKind
FindingChangeKind.description:
Per-finding diff event class.

Identity for the diff is ``(canonical_vuln_id, component_name,
component_version)`` — see ADR-0008 §7.2 for why we don't use the
finding's ``cpe`` (often missing for non-OS packages) or ``component_id``
FK (nullable).

``kev_added`` is intentionally absent. See ADR-0008 §11 PB-3.

FindingDiffRow.title: FindingDiffRow
FindingDiffRow.description: One row in the Findings tab of the Compare view.

FindingFixResponse.title: FindingFixResponse

FindingsTrendResponse.title: FindingsTrendResponse
FindingsTrendResponse.description:
v2 response shape for ``GET /dashboard/trend``.

``points`` is the canonical field; ``series`` is a one-release alias kept
so the v1 frontend (under feature flag) continues to render until Phase 4
ships. Both arrays carry the same data — the alias is removed in the
follow-up cleanup release per the redesign doc §9.2.

``runs_total`` and ``runs_distinct_dates`` are the canonical inputs the
FE empty-state needs; they replace the FE-side ``populatedDays`` heuristic
that mis-counted runs as days (Bug 2 / Bug 6 lock — see
``docs/dashboard-metrics-spec.md`` §5).

ImportedVexAssertion.title: ImportedVexAssertion
ImportedVexAssertion.description:
One imported assertion.

Every assertion is listed, including ones that are not applicable to this
component version and ones that conflict with another source — hiding them
is what VEX-INV-005 forbids.

anyOf.description: Tenant Membership public UUID, distinct from User UUID.

InvestigationAssignmentRequest.title: InvestigationAssignmentRequest
InvestigationAssignmentRequest.description: Assign or unassign a context (spec section 27, audited).

InvestigationDecisionRequest.title: InvestigationDecisionRequest
InvestigationDecisionRequest.description:
A manual determination on one context (VEX-INV-003, VEX-AUD-001/002).

``row_version`` is required: an analyst must be editing the version they
were shown. A mismatch returns 409 with the current row rather than
overwriting someone else's decision.

InvestigationDetail.title: InvestigationDetail
InvestigationDetail.description: Spec section 29 — evidence kept side by side, never merged.

InvestigationListResponse.title: InvestigationListResponse
InvestigationListResponse.description: Envelope matching the repo's other server-paginated lists.

InvestigationMappingRequest.title: InvestigationMappingRequest
InvestigationMappingRequest.description:
Bind an UNRESOLVED_MAPPING context to a component (VEX-MAP-001).

Only an analyst may do this: the matcher refuses to guess between weak
candidates, and a wrong binding would attach someone's determination to
the wrong component.

InvestigationRow.title: InvestigationRow
InvestigationRow.description: One row of the investigation queue (spec section 27).

InvestigationSummaryResponse.title: InvestigationSummaryResponse
InvestigationSummaryResponse.description:
Metrics for exactly the contexts the queue matches (VEX-DASH-004).

``total`` equals the list endpoint's ``total`` for the same filters.
``mapped_total`` excludes unresolved mappings and always equals
``affected + not_affected + fixed + under_investigation`` (VEX-DASH-002);
``unresolved_mapping_count`` reports the rest separately.

since.title: Since
since.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD dateAdded cutoff. Empty syncs the full catalog.

prune_stale.title: Prune Stale
prune_stale.description: Remove local KEV CVEs absent from a full-feed sync. Ignored for since-filtered syncs.

LifetimeMetrics.title: LifetimeMetrics
LifetimeMetrics.description:
Lifetime / cumulative counts. These only go up over time — by design.

The "Your Analyzer, So Far" panel exists to answer the user's implicit
question "has the tool been working for me?". Surfacing deltas would
distract from that story; see ``docs/dashboard-redesign.md`` §6 for the
rationale and the explicit anti-pattern list.

compatibility_evidence.title: Compatibility Evidence
compatibility_evidence.description: known_breaking_api, known_breaking_abi, unsupported_runtimes, unsupported_operating_systems, unsupported_architectures, regulatory_block, transitive_dependencies_reviewed

ModelInfo.title: ModelInfo
ModelInfo.description:
One bootstrap model used only before live discovery is possible.

``default_tier`` is the *expected* tier for this model. Free-tier
models on cloud providers (Gemini Flash, Grok 2 Mini) carry rate
limits the orchestrator honors via the per-provider rate limiter.

NetChange.title: NetChange
NetChange.description:
Time-windowed delta with explicit first-period signaling.

``is_first_period`` is the lock for Bug 5: when no successful run
completed strictly before ``today − window_days``, the comparison is
undefined. The FE renders "first scan this week — comparison available
next week" instead of ``+N / −0``.

See ``docs/dashboard-metrics-spec.md`` §3.7.

api_key_masked.title: Api Key Masked
api_key_masked.description: Masked form (first3...last3) or '(not set)'. Plaintext never returned.

NvdSettingsResponse.title: NvdSettingsResponse
NvdSettingsResponse.description: Read-side projection — never includes plaintext API key.

NvdSettingsUpdate.title: NvdSettingsUpdate
NvdSettingsUpdate.description:
PATCH-like update payload.

Tri-state for ``api_key``:
  * field omitted          → preserve existing value
  * ``api_key="..."``      → set to the supplied plaintext
  * ``clear_api_key=True`` → clear the stored ciphertext

All other fields: omitted → preserve, present → set.

row_version.title: Row Version
row_version.description: 0 when the tenant has no override yet

PostureDelta.title: PostureDelta
PostureDelta.description:
Region 2 of the Compare UI. Three count-based deltas anchored to public
sources, plus the v1 distribution bar promoted, plus side-by-side
severity composition for Tab 3.

No multiplicative scalar. No portfolio "risk score." See
ADR-0008 §11 PB-1 — reintroducing the scalar would contradict the
Risk Index removal recorded in ``docs/risk-index.md``.

ProviderCatalogEntry.title: ProviderCatalogEntry
ProviderCatalogEntry.description:
Catalog metadata for one provider.

Returned by ``GET /api/v1/ai/providers/available``. The Settings UI
reads this to drive form rendering — which fields appear, what
validation to apply, what tier badges to show.

is_local.title: Is Local
is_local.description: True for self-hosted (Ollama / vLLM); used for cost reporting.

ProviderInfo.title: ProviderInfo
ProviderInfo.description: Public-facing description used by the registry and Settings UI.

RemediationProse.title: RemediationProse
RemediationProse.description:
2-4 sentence user-facing summary of the finding in context.

Length is enforced at validator level — trimming a 6-sentence response
is preferable to surfacing a wall of text. The prompt instructs the
model on length, but defence in depth lives here too.

direction_warning.title: Direction Warning
direction_warning.description: Set when run B is older than run A (likely user picked the wrong order).

RunRelationship.title: RunRelationship
RunRelationship.description: How A and B relate. Drives the one-line descriptor under the pickers.

RunSummary.title: RunSummary
RunSummary.description: Compact view of a run for the compare header / picker.

RunsAggregateBuckets.title: RunsAggregateBuckets
RunsAggregateBuckets.description: Run-status outcome counts. Sums to ``total_runs`` (I-A invariant).

RunsAggregateOut.title: RunsAggregateOut
RunsAggregateOut.description:
Server-side aggregate for the Analysis Runs page tiles.

Replaces the FE-side reduce that filtered on legacy ``PASS``/``FAIL``
strings (audit §I0.4-F1) and silently undercounted above 100 runs (F2).

SBOMComponentListItem.title: SBOMComponentListItem
SBOMComponentListItem.description: Component row enriched for list views (canonical duplicate references).

message.title: Message
message.default: SBOM uploaded successfully. Enrichment is running in background.

SbomAcceptedResponse.title: SbomAcceptedResponse
SbomAcceptedResponse.description: Response body for a successful upload.

ScheduleResolved.title: ScheduleResolved
ScheduleResolved.description:
Returned by ``GET /api/sboms/{id}/schedule``. The ``schedule`` field
is the effective row (own override or inherited from project), or
``None`` if neither exists. ``inherited`` is true when the SBOM is
currently following its project's cascade.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA name; display only — firing is computed in UTC

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: CUSTOM or EXCLUDED; absence of a row means INHERIT

min_gap_minutes.title: Min Gap Minutes
min_gap_minutes.description: Skip a tick if a manual or prior run completed within this many minutes

ScheduleUpsert.title: ScheduleUpsert
ScheduleUpsert.description:
Friendly create/update payload — the API accepts cadence presets and
derives the cron expression server-side. CUSTOM cadence is for power
users only and surfaces under an "Advanced" disclosure in the UI.

SeverityCounts.title: SeverityCounts
SeverityCounts.description:
Severity bucket counts in the latest-successful-run-per-SBOM scope.

``unknown`` is a *data-quality* signal (no CVSS score in our feeds) and is
rendered separately in the hero pill — not as a fifth "severity tier."
See ``docs/terminology.md``.

TenantCreateRequest.title: TenantCreateRequest
TenantCreateRequest.description: Syntax-only contract; domain normalization lives in tenant_service.

TenantUserCandidate.title: TenantUserCandidate
TenantUserCandidate.description: Minimal identity projection for attaching an existing account.

TestConnectionRequest.title: TestConnectionRequest
TestConnectionRequest.description:
Body for ``POST /credentials/test``.

Either supplies a complete provider config (un-saved test before
save) OR a credential_id (saved-row re-test). ``api_key`` is
accepted only on the un-saved path; saved rows decrypt their key
server-side.

TopCachedItem.title: TopCachedItem
TopCachedItem.description: One row of the "most expensive cached fixes" leaderboard.

TrendAnnotation.title: TrendAnnotation
TrendAnnotation.description:
Event marker overlaid on the trend chart.

``count`` lets the frontend stack multiple events on the same day with a
single ▼ marker that opens to a list when there are more than three.

TrendDataPoint.title: TrendDataPoint
TrendDataPoint.description:
One day's severity breakdown. ``unknown`` is first-class in v2 (it
used to be silently dropped — see ``docs/dashboard-v2-audit.md`` §3.3).

TrendPoint.title: TrendPoint
TrendPoint.description: One day in the cost trend sparkline.

provider_name.title: Provider Name
provider_name.description: Override the default provider for this run.

budget_usd.title: Budget Usd
budget_usd.description: Override per-scan budget for this run only.

scope.description: Scope spec — restricts the batch to a subset of findings. When None or empty, processes every finding in the run (legacy behaviour).

enqueued.title: Enqueued
enqueued.description: True when the Celery task accepted the job; False = ran inline.

total.title: Total
total.description: Number of findings in scope after resolution.

cached_count.title: Cached Count
cached_count.description: How many of those findings already have cached fixes.

UpgradeCommand.title: UpgradeCommand
UpgradeCommand.description:
Concrete, copy-paste-ready remediation command.

``tested_against_data`` is the load-bearing field — the
:class:`AiFixGenerator` post-validation step ensures it can ONLY be
``True`` when ``target_version`` actually appears in the upstream
fix-version list. The model is allowed to *suggest* a version it
inferred, but the bit gets flipped to ``False`` server-side if the
suggestion is not in the data. This is the schema-level half of the
hallucination defence — the prompt-level half is in the prompt files.

ValidationErrorEntry.title: ValidationErrorEntry
ValidationErrorEntry.description:
One entry of the persisted validation report, enriched for the UI.

Mirrors :class:`app.validation.errors.ValidationError` plus
``stage_number`` (1-8 from the canonical pipeline). The frontend's
error card renders these fields verbatim — every field on this model
must reach the DOM somewhere.

ValidationReportResponse.title: ValidationReportResponse
ValidationReportResponse.description:
Full validation report for an SBOM detail page.

The detail page leads with this when ``status != 'validated'``. The
summary aggregations (``severity_summary`` / ``stage_summary``) are
pre-computed server-side so the UI can render badges without
